com.vector.cfg.consistency.groovy.extensions

Class GroovyConsistencyMethodExtensions

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.vector.cfg.consistency.groovy.extensions.GroovyConsistencyMethodExtensions

  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public final class GroovyConsistencyMethodExtensions
extends java.lang.Object
    This class contains consistency-related groovy-extension-methods, e.g. for getting validation-results of an MIObject or DefRef.

    • Method Detail

      • getValidationResults

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.Collection<IValidationResultUI> getValidationResults(DefRef defRef)
        DefRef.getValidationResults() returns all validation-results which match the passed definition. So every configuration element which matches the validation-result and is an instance of definition. The used project for this call is the active project, see ScriptApi.getActiveProject().
        Parameters:
        defRef - the def ref
        Returns:
        the validation results

      • getValidationResults

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.Collection<IValidationResultUI> getValidationResults(IViewedModelObject self)
        Returns the IValidationResultUIs for the model object.
        IViewedModelObject.getValidationResults() returns the validation-results for the element matching the model object and the model view, like BswmdModel objects.

        The following condition must be true to match: 

         IValidationResultUI.matchErroneousCE(theObject) &&
 (
   IValidationResultUI.isGeneralVariantContext() ||
   IValidationResultUI.getPredefinedVariantContexts().contains(theView)
 )

        Parameters:
        self - the model object
        Returns:
        the validation results
        See Also:
        IValidationResultUI.matchErroneousCE(IViewedModelObject)

      • getValidationResults

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.Collection<IValidationResultUI> getValidationResults(MIObject self)
        Returns the IValidationResultUIs for the model object.
        MIObject.getValidationResults() returns the validation-results of an MIObject. These are those results for which IValidationResultUI.matchErroneousCE(MIObject) returns true.
        Parameters:
        self - the model object
        Returns:
        the validation results

      • getValidationResultsRecursive

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.Collection<IValidationResultUI> getValidationResultsRecursive(IViewedModelObject self)
        Returns the IValidationResultUIs for the model object and all its children.
        IViewedModelObject.getValidationResultsRecursive() returns the validation-results of an MIObject for the elements like BswmdModel objects all its children. This will also filter for the correct IModelView. So this will return all results of the whole subtree, like an editor displays results at parent objects.
        Parameters:
        self - the model object
        Returns:
        the validation results
